# Ramen broth

Pork and chicken broth for a weekend batch of ramen. Blanch 2 kg of pork trotters and chicken backs for ten minutes,
scrub off the scum, then simmer hard for twelve hours with the lid off so the fat emulsifies and the broth goes
milky.

## Tare and toppings

The tare is a shio base: kombu soaked overnight, salt, a splash of mirin and some of the fermented garlic honey from
the pantry. Toppings are a jammy egg marinated in soy for six hours, scallion and a sheet of nori. #cooking
